item.title: Planned Amazon data center could become the biggest climate polluter in the U.S.
item.description: As part of a planned Texas data center, Amazon is investing in an on-site power plant that could reportedly become the largest source of climate pollution in the United States.

item.title: X replaces its revenue-sharing program with ‘Original Content Rewards’
item.description: X is ending its controversial revenue-sharing program for content creators, which has seen numerous revisions under Elon Musk's reign. In its place, it's launching a new Original Content Rewards program on September 8th. To be eligible, creators must have at least 500 verified followers and at least 500,000 Home Timeline impressions from verified users in […]...

item.title: New drone system which could spot wildfires before they get out of control completes its first test — but is it too late for the summer blazes plaguing Europe?
item.description: Israel tests AI wildfire-detection drone, although additional evaluations mean Europe will not benefit from it during this year's fire season.
